node.name: misc_dir/rc_sticky
node.scope: Unchanged native and deployed C reference-count assertions through the installed application linker; not a public foreign-code CLI
adaptations: The original C source, shell driver, empty LEANC_OPTS and runtime assertions are unchanged.
Only the exact deployed leanc -o rc_sticky.produced rc_sticky.c invocation uses an explicit adapter; unexpected arguments fail.
The installed Lean application linker supplies its usual C optimization, Wasm ABI and host support.

One guarded workload with one linker worker; build deadline 1800 seconds, runtime deadline 120 seconds.

limitations: Main fixtures and one upstream C case do not establish complete API or suite compatibility.
The C adapter is a private parallel test harness and does not add a public C compilation API.
Node and Deno use memory64; Bun retains the existing lowered memory64 recipe and its unresolved high-address/large-stack gaps.
Cold installation, HTTP and broader filesystem acceptance are separate gates.
